name: V24
description: Two-stage bone tumor screener: EfficientNet-B3 gate (300px) + EfficientNet-B6 specialist (456px), fine-tuned on the entity families the error anatomy flagged (ABC, bone island, chondroblastoma, CMF, BFH, chondrosarcoma, adamantinoma, chordoma, angiosarcoma, GCT, fibrous dysplasia, metastases).

headline.note: measured single-view, gate 0.30, malignant threshold 0.25. V21 scored 523/564 with 165/179 on the same set.

wild.note: 199 real-world radiographs (Radiology Assistant + bonetumor.org), gate 0.30, malignant threshold 0.25. V21 scored 98/199 (49.2%) with 50/95 cancers on the identical protocol. Held-out 78-film slice: 62.8% vs V21's 53.8%.
